Own and remote body/head/kill, armored hit, miss, melee hit; quiet and competing gunfire/explosion. Correlate accepted hit tick, animation contact, playback start and perceived click.
Bow draw cancel/release/end, rifle/pistol/launcher shot, dry trigger, reload cancel, shells/ricochet; near/mid/far listener and blocked/unblocked line.
Tree/ore first hit, repeat hit, weak spot, stage change and depletion; correlate frame spike and waveform onset.
Eat/drink/bandage/inject, equipment, locks/doors, place/upgrade/repair/demolish, crafting/research/recycler/fire, inventory attachment drag.
Each animal calm/alert/threat/attack/hurt/death, gait and repeat intervals; each biome day/night, shore, inside/outside, changing weather when implemented.
Tin Finch/Iron Wake outside/deck/bridge; start/load/boost/release/shutdown/touchdown, cannons/loader/turrets, rockets/fire/explosion at distance.
